decisions.finding: Below the head recession, a distinct low-left lobe is separated from the head by a clear open white channel and adjoins only the continuing right tail. Its location matches the detached36 dagesh; paired15 pointed yod repeats the extra branch. The second yod in the same word, local vayehi and hayu yods and paired15 plain yod each continue as a tail without that left branch. This whole contour defeats plain thick printing. Append BC after existing B7, leaving every prior scalar and combining order intact.

inspections.finding: The complete Daniel yod has a shallow left notch and low-left re-expansion, but the whole interior remains one opaque bulky impression. The paired pointed control resembles that outline; however the tail cannot be separated from variable heavy plain printing. Three local plain yods from the same complete source unit and the paired15 plain control constrain the comparison without uniquely defeating that competitor. Retain the exact dagesh note; width or expected Daniel spelling does not authorize BC or absence.

The complete initial vav ends in a broad rounded basal platform continuously joined to the stem. A distinct bar, horizontal pair, vertical pair or stemmed point cannot be isolated; the literal bar/pair/stem/single-node and ordinary vav-foot controls leave multiple competitors. Retain the vowel note and update only the full anchor for the independently certified neighboring yod BC.

Its location matches the detached36 dagesh; paired15 pointed yod repeats the extra branch. The second yod in the same word, local vayehi and hayu yods and paired15 plain yod each continue as a tail without that left branch. This whole contour defeats plain thick printing. The complete initial vav carries a flat basal platform continuously attached to the long stem. No unique vowel topology survives. Literal detached bar, horizontal pair, stemmed qamats, single node and two-level vav-sheva controls do not distinguish a merged point from an ordinary heavy terminal. Retain the exact vowel note without asserting source absence.
